title: Reliable virtual clutch binding
summary: This release makes combined-clutch setup and vJoy binding more dependable.
highlights: Capture now explains the full one-paddle, other-paddle, then both-paddles sequence and saves a successful clutch setup automatically.
A delayed vJoy-only axis test binds LMU without the physical wheel competing for the same assignment.
Pivot reports clearly when another feeder such as SimHub owns its configured vJoy device.
The clutch setup footer has improved separation, and the one-time What's new dialog is recorded as soon as it first appears.
